slot. Unofficial community extension.
# DeepSeek Harness for VS Code

> **Unofficial community extension** — not affiliated with DeepSeek.
> The DeepSeek Harness runtime

is MIT-licensed open source (deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).
>
> 非官方社区扩展，与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属关系。DeepSeek
Harness 本体是 MIT 协议的开源项目。
**Landing page:** https://swording-k.github.io/dsh-vscode/
## Install  /  安装

**From GitHub (available now):** download `dsh-vscode-<version>.vsix` from
Releases, then run
**Exte
nsions: Install from VSIX…** from the Command Palette (`Cmd+Shift+P` on macOS).
**From the Marketplace:** search **DeepSeek Harness** in the Extensions view.
## What it does  /  它做什么

Put DeepSeek Harness in your editor: the **left launcher** shows your folder's
conversations; one cl

ick opens the full GUI **beside the editor** — ready to
read and write your source tree.
用 VS Code 管理 DeepSeek Harness 对话：左侧启动器列出当前文件夹的历史对话，一点就在编辑器右侧打开完整 GUI，直接读写你的项目文件。
## Entry points  /  入口（four places to reach it）
| Location | What |
| Left side bar (activity bar) | Whale icon → launcher with folder name, session list, and a new-cha

t button |
| Secondary side bar (right) | Same launcher, native right-side slot (VS Code ≥ 1.94) |
|

Editor title (top-right) | Whale button → new conversation for the active folder |
| Status bar (bo

ttom-right) | `DSH` → open the launcher |
| Command palette | `DSH: Open Panel`, `DSH: New Conversat
ion`, `DSH: Refresh Conversations` |
## Prerequisites  /  先决条件

- Node.js ≥ 22
- DeepSeek Harness: `npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`
The extension calls the `dsh` executa

ble on PATH by default, or a
checkout when `dshHarness.repoPath` is set.
- An API key: set `DEEPSEEK

_API_KEY` in your environment or use `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`.
The GUI's built-in Account settings
let you enter the key on first launch.
## Usage  /  使用

1. Click the DeepSeek Harness icon in the left side bar (or use any entry point above).
2. The launc

her shows your VS Code folder and its conversations; click **`+ New Conversation`**
or pick a saved

one. The full DSH GUI opens **on the right**, ready to read/write
your workspace files.
3. The serve

r starts automatically on first use; the theme follows your
VS Code colour scheme (disable `dshHarne
ss.syncTheme` if you prefer manual control).
## Settings  /  设置
| Setting | Default | Notes |
| `dshHarness.repoPath` | `""` | Optional path to a deepseek-harness source checkout (leave empty to

rely on `dsh` from PATH) |
| `dshHarness.command` | `dsh` | Executable used when `repoPath` is empt

y (e.g. `dsh`, `pnpm dsh`) |
| `dshHarness.port` | `3080` | dsh web server port |
| `dshHarness.auto

Start` | `true` | Start the server automatically when it is not running |
| `dshHarness.syncTheme` |
`true` | Keep the DSH colour scheme in sync with your VS Code theme |
## Publishing  /  发布

The extension ships with a companion `dsh-plugin-deep-link` client plugin under
`plugin/`. On a stoc

k `dsh` install it is auto-installed into the web profile
via `dsh plugin --profile web add …`. A so

urce checkout already includes the
deep-link patch and does not need it.
Before publishing to the Marketplace:

1. Create a publisher: VS Code Marketplace → create publisher.
2. Generate a Personal Access Token (

Azure DevOps → Marketplace scope → **Manage**).
3. Log in: `npx @vscode/vsce login <publisher-id>`.

4. Replace `publisher` in `package.json` with your publisher id.
5. Replace the placeholder `reposit

ory.url` in `package.json` with your real GitHub repo URL.
6. Run `npm run package` (produces a `.vs
ix`) then `npx @vscode/vsce publish`.
## Known issues  /  已知限制

- Session targeting via `#session=<id>` relies on the `dsh-plugin-deep-link`
plugin. Stock `@deepsee

k-ai/dsh` users get it auto-installed; source-checkout
users on the `custom` branch already have it

patched. Without either, the GUI
opens normally and you select the conversation in the GUI sidebar —

one extra click.
- The secondary side bar slot is not shown on VS Code builds older than 1.94.
- Mu
lti-root workspaces are not yet supported (only the first folder is aligned).
